notes.title: Update to Ver.1.0.2 (Function added and Bug fixed)
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fixed[/h1][olist]
[*] Other than supporting languages’ (Korean, English, French, German, Japanese) region will automatically use English as a default.
[*]  We have noticed some players get startled when dice hit the ground and hear the loud sound effect. We adjusted the volume to prevent from it.
[*] During the middle of the game when the player calls a menu robot, it sometimes hit the cube objects. We have fixed this issue, and a robot will no longer disturb gameplay.
[*] If the player goes off the stage level, the player will see unity default’s skybox. We have changed it to space background.
[/olist]
[h1]Function added[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Option button that can turn “BGM” or “Sound Effect” On/Off is added to the main menu. 
[*]When teleporting, now the player can choose orientation fixed or changeable. When this option is turned off, a player will face the same direction even after the teleport to the new location.
[/olist]
